g.title: SHIELD_CTRL
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — jumpers and control pins

AS BUILT: caps on MS1 + MS3 under every driver = 1/32 (M0+M2), MS2 open. Two jumpers on the A header = D12/D13 drive the A axis. 10 kΩ from EN to 5V (pull-up) so the drivers stay OFF during R4 resets. Caps on before the drivers.

g.title: R_EN
g.text: Consumables. Without it, D8 floats LOW during the R4's ~1 s reset and all four drivers sit at full current uncommanded.

g.title: X_MOT
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — X driver motor header (BL)
4-pin male header beside the X socket. Driver STEP = D2, DIR = D5, EN = D8 shared. Firmware map: BL = X.

g.title: W_BL
g.text: 4-pin Dupont, 1.5 A per phase (2 A contacts): any pin that warms in the wheels-up test gets re-crimped

g.title: M_BL
g.text: Find the pairs with the meter: the two leads that read ~1.5–2 Ω are ONE coil. Lead colours vary between batches — the meter, not the colour, decides.
